description: Swiss electricity system modeling -- HV grid - hydropower topology and inflows - renewable productions - past and forecast meteorological data is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. This dataset contains several useful components for Swiss Electricity system modeling: 1. High-voltage Swiss grid: 2019 snapshot of the high-voltage (-150kV) grid composed of: - Nodes: names, voltage, position. - Lines: ends nodes, resistance, power capacity. - Transformers: ends nodes, power capacity, resistance, tap ratio. 2. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher EnviDat: das Umwelt-Datenportal. It offers 7 resource(s) in OCTET, TXT, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
